items.title: Tesla Autopilot under scrutiny after crash involving 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination Overtime to discuss the Tesla (TSLA) Autopilot incident that may have played a role in a crash involving San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan and what it could mean for the carmaker going forward.

items.title: Tesla in the spotlight as NFL's 49ers head coach says Autopilot may have been engaged during accident
items.summary: Tesla is in the spotlight after news that the company's self-driving software may have played a part in an accident involving the head coach of the NFL's San Francisco 49ers.

items.title: Tesla needs Robotaxi flywheel proof to boost investor conviction: Morgan Stanley
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley told clients in a note on Tuesday that Tesla will need clearer evidence that its Robotaxi effort is scaling to strengthen investor conviction, following feedback from conversations after the company's second-quarter earnings.
